name: Doncaster Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Doncaster Baptist Church. Open Tue 11am-2pm and Fri 10am-1pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Doncaster Council Allotments
description: Doncaster Council manages sites at Town Moor
image: and Balby. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: Doncaster Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Sandall Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Large park with lake and wildlife.
